`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) already migrates the COVER
sorry-free, and the adaptation's equations and `eqn_rel` transport with it because the pieces
are literally the same opens, only reindexed along `finSumFinEquiv`.

The migration of the CERTIFICATE is landed too, in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`
(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_toAff`, all seven clauses).  Clauses (c1) are `rfl` at the
relabelled index; the glued clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transport along `LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft`
in its `symm` direction, which evaluates cast-free, so the intertwining with
`deltaLeft`/`deltaRight` is componentwise and `Module.rankAtStalk` invariance is
`rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv`.  No clause changes, only the index does.

A predecessor docstring here estimated that transport at about a hundred lines of equalizer
bookkeeping.  That was wrong by an order of magnitude and the reason generalises: arrange the
reindexed cover so its pieces are DEFINITIONALLY the original pieces at the relabelled index,
and the overlap data at `(i, j)` becomes `rfl`-equal to the original at `(e i, e j)`, because
reindexing acts diagonally on the pair index.  Then no intertwining lemma exists to prove. -/

/-! ## The widened functor value -/

variable (C R) (n : ℕ)

/-- The divisor-equality setoid on widened locally-certified systems. -/
def divFamZarAffSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} where
  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
  iseqv :=
    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

/-- **The widened divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`** (R2, I-0492): locally
certified systems of degree `n` up to divisor equality, where "certified" is now witnessed by
arbitrary affine-open covers of the relative curve.

This is the carrier that is field-uniform: no hypothesis on `|P¹(k)|` appears anywhere in its
definition or in the per-piece layer that produces it. -/
def DivFamZarAff : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n)

namespace DivFamZarAff

variable {C R n}

/-- The class of a widened locally certified system. -/
def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) :
    DivFamZarAff C R n :=
  Quotient.mk (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n) ⟨d, hd⟩

lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₂} :
    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarAffSetoid C R n)

/-- **The Picard class of a widened divisor class** `𝒪(D)`, well defined by
`picClass_eq_of_divEq`.  This is the Abel hook DAT-C consumes, unchanged by the widening. -/
noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
  Quotient.lift
    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} =>
      d.1.picClass)
    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F

@[simp]
lemma picClass_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) : picClass (mk d hd) = d.picClass :=
  rfl

end DivFamZarAff

/-! ## The pointwise gate over the widened predicate -/

variable {C R n}

/-- **The pointwise certificate gate, widened.** If over every prime of the base there is an
away localization carrying a widened certified family divisor-equal to the pulled system, the
system is widened-locally certified.  Same quasi-compactness step as
`isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_away` (`DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean`): the good
elements' basic opens cover `Spec R`, so finitely many span the unit ideal.

This is the shape the geometry produces — the support tube isolates pieces over a
neighbourhood of ONE base point, and every fibre analysis reads at a single prime. -/

    {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧

              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))) :

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSurjectiveEffectivity
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyMonoH1
import Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.Finite

/-!
# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route

This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.

The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation

/- The degree theorem needs the base-change geometric package under the local relCurve instance,
   which has lower priority in the general curve API. -/
noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneLocalDivisorOver
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
  instOverBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorSmooth
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorIntegral
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorQuasiCompact
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorFiniteH0
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance rankOneLocalDivisorFiniteH1
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L

/-! ## Regularity and degree of the local equations -/

/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    (z : relCurve C L) :
    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by
  let B := Localization.Away f
  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q
  have hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
      s q (hsec q) j
  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
    s hfib L z

/-- The local equations have the genus class degree after every field-valued extension.  The
calculation uses the datum class law and datum_classDeg_baseChange, so the degree is tied to
the presentation rather than supplied as an unrelated witness. -/
theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L] :
    classDeg L
      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass) = genus C := by
  letI : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L :=
    ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) L).comp
      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f) L :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  haveI : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, RingHom.comp_assoc,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f),
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k (Localization.Away f) L])
  rw [P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy,
    P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange (Localization.Away f),
    ← MonoidHom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.CechPic.map_comp,
    relCurveMap_comp]
  exact P.datum_classDeg_baseChange L

/-! ## The local widened divisor and its immediate consumer -/

/- The next canonicality edge is expressed first in the localized H⁰ module.  The datum
   section/native comparison needed to transport this unit to local equations is deliberately
   a separate contract. -/
theorem existsUnique_unit_tensorAway_rankOne_generators
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    ∃! v : (Localization.Away f)ˣ,
      ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y') =
        (v : Localization.Away f) •
          ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) := by
  let B := Localization.Away f
  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
  have hrankB : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
      Module.rankAtStalk (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) q = 1 := by
    intro q
    rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
    exact P.h0_rank_one (PrimeSpectrum.comap
      (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B) q)
  exact Module.existsUnique_unit_smul_of_forall_tmul_ne_zero
    hrankB ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y')
    (AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
      f y hy)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.tensorAwayGenerator_fibre_ne_zero
      f y' hy')

/-- The widened divisor cut by a tied rank-one section on its basic open. -/
noncomputable def baseOpenRankOneDivisor
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away f) (genus C) :=
  divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations C (genus C)
    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) pi
    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular f y hy)
    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_classDeg f y hy)

@[simp]
theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
  unfold baseOpenRankOneDivisor
  rw [picClass_divFamZarAffOfFibrewiseRegularLocalEquations]
  exact P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass f y hy

/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
  let B := Localization.Away f
  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
    rfl
  calc
    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]
    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi
      (PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
      rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (PicEtAff.mapAlg C iota (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
      congr 1
      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

/-- Every base point of a rank-one presentation has a tied local widened divisor.  The final
conjunct retains the native counit identity for the very same section. -/
theorem exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
        (hy : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),
        (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass ∧
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, heval⟩ := P.exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator p
  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy, heval⟩

/-- Every base point has one tied local divisor whose Abel value is the restriction of the
input class and whose defining section satisfies the native evaluation identity. -/
theorem exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
        (hy : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),
        abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
            PicEtAff.mapAlg C
              ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
              (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
                (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) ∧
          (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy).picClass =
              (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass ∧
            (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
              ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
                (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
              (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, hclass, heval⟩ :=
    P.exists_baseOpen_rankOne_divisor_with_evaluation p
  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff f y hy, hclass, heval⟩

end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# DDR-8 — the relative mono / Law-1 core (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 7)
    11	
    12	The **relative mono**: two certified divisor families over the test ring `R` whose
    13	embedding pairs `ε` agree are equal in `DivFam` (i.e. cut the same divisor, `DivEq`).
    14	This is the relative-level upgrade of DD-4 Task 6's field-level mono
    15	(`AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_divFamEps_eq`, I-0214) and is the Law-1 input DDR-9 consumes
    16	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 8; Addendum 1, restated against `DivFamZar` — DDR-8 is
    17	per-certified-representative, hence unaffected, and feeds the restated DDR-9 unchanged).
    18	
    19	## The route (spec §3 item 7)
    20	
    21	`DivEq d₁ d₂` (`Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq`) asks, on a common refinement of the two
    22	covers, for the local equations to differ by a **unit** at every point — a *relative*
    23	unit over `R`, not merely a fibrewise one.  The spec route is: fibrewise both families
    24	present the base divisor `bd(K_M ⊗ κ(p))` (DDR-2's certified-degree pinch +
    25	`baseDivisorAt_window_normalization`), so at each residue field the two equations have
    26	equal `ordZ` at every closed point (`coeffAt_eq_toAdd_ordZ_eqn`), i.e. their ratio is a
    27	fibrewise unit; the colon-Tor pair upgrades fibrewise divisibility both ways to relative
    28	divisibility, and residue-nonvanishing turns "each divides the other" into a relative
    29	unit — hence `DivEq`.
    30	
    31	This file lands the **argument assembled on those inputs**, in two layers.
    32	
    33	* **§1 — the general upgrade** `Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_stalkIdeal_eq`

   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']

   165	    ((D.termBaseChange₀ B').prodCongr (D.termBaseChange₁ B'))

   169	    (p : (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   170	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :
   171	    D.datumDomBaseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   172	      (D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.1), D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.2)) := by
   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   174	  rfl

   176	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/
   182	theorem datumDiffBaseChange
   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm

   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans
   233	    ((RigidEngine.kerCongr ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')
   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)
   235	        (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   236	        (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x)).trans
   237	      ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
   238	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   239	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	        (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).symm)
   241	
   242	/-- **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing locus: the base-changed Čech
   243	differential is surjective (right-exactness of `B' ⊗[B] -` plus the δ-square), so `H¹` of the
   244	base-changed datum sheaf vanishes. -/
   245	theorem datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   246	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) := by
   247	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair D).diff :=
   248	    D.pairData.surjective_diff (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   249	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1
   250	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') := by
   251	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
   252	    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B' hsurj
   253	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff :=
   254	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   255	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x) hbc
   256	  haveI : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1 := by
   257	    have h : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ := by
   258	      rw [← (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
   259	      exact hsurj'
   260	    rw [TwoLatticePair.H1, h]
   261	    infer_instance
   262	  exact ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h1Equiv
   263	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   264	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   265	    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).toEquiv.subsingleton

     9	# Base change of the pinned cocycle datum (DAT-1, stage 1d-ii, the datum half)
    10	
    11	The `relCocycleBaseChange`-style base change of the basic-open cocycle datum
    12	(`informal/spec-dat-1.md` stage (1d-ii), first bullet; worksheet §3.2 — **this is the
    13	RE-5 transport interface**): along a `k`-algebra map `B → B'`, the generators, partition
    14	coefficients and transition units of a `Scheme.BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` push forward
    15	through the relative-curve comparison morphism `relCurveMap C B B'` to a datum over `B'`,
    16	with the pieces mapping to pieces (`Scheme.preimage_basicOpen`) and the partition/cocycle
    17	identities carried by `map_*`.
    18	
    19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom` — `appLE` commutes with restriction on
    20	  both sides (the workhorse; both sides collapse to one `appLE` by
    21	  `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance).
    22	* `relSectionsMap_basicOpen` — basic opens of compared sections are preimages of basic
    23	  opens.
    24	* `relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap` — the comparison intertwines the structure algebra
    25	  maps along `algebraMap B B'`, over **arbitrary** opens (the pullback-open case is the
    26	  landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`).
    27	* `BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange` / `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange` — the datum base
    28	  change, with `pieces_baseChange` (pieces map to pieces).
    29	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMap` — the componentwise comparison of glued sections
    30	  `F_D(W) → F_{D'}(W')` for `W' ≤ relCurveMap ⁻¹ᵁ W`, additive
    31	  (`sectionsMap_add`), semilinear along `algebraMap B B'` (`sectionsMap_smul`),
    32	  commuting with restriction (`gluedRes_sectionsMap`), intertwining the piece
    33	  trivializations with the section comparison (`gluedTriv_sectionsMap`) and the
    34	  componentwise chart actions (`sectionsMap_gluedQsmul`) — the inputs of the stage
    35	  (1d-ii) term identifications and the RE-5 transport.

    50	/-! ## `appLE` against restriction, on arbitrary opens -/
    51	
    52	/-- **`appLE` commutes with restriction**: for `f : X ⟶ Y`, restricting the `appLE`
    53	image of a section equals the `appLE` image of the restricted section. Both sides are
    54	`f.appLE W PW'` of the section, by `appLE_map`/`map_appLE` and proof irrelevance of the
    55	inclusion witnesses. -/
    56	lemma Scheme.Hom.appLE_resHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X.Hom Y) {W' W : Y.Opens}
    57	    {PW' PW : X.Opens} (hW : W' ≤ W) (ePW : PW ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (ePW' : PW' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ W')
    58	    (hP : PW' ≤ PW) (s : Γ(Y, W)) :
    59	    X.resHom hP ((f.appLE W PW ePW).hom s) =
    60	      (f.appLE W' PW' ePW').hom (Y.resHom hW s) := by
    61	  have h1 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    62	    $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map f ePW (homOfLE hP).op)) s)
    63	  have h2 := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    64	    $(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f ePW' (homOfLE hW).op)) s)
    65	  exact h1.trans h2.symm

    75	/-- **Basic opens base-change to basic opens**: the basic open of the compared section
    76	`relSectionsMap s` is the `relCurveMap`-preimage of the basic open of `s`. -/
    77	theorem relSectionsMap_basicOpen (V : C.left.Opens)
    78	    (s : Γ(relCurve C B, (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    79	    (relCurve C B').basicOpen (relSectionsMap C B B' V s) =
    80	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((relCurve C B).basicOpen s) := by
    81	  have happ : relSectionsMap C B B' V s =
    82	      (relCurve C B').resHom
    83	        (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm :
    84	          (fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤
    85	            relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    86	        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) := by
    87	    have h := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    88	      $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (relCurveMap C B B')
    89	        (le_refl (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
    90	        (homOfLE (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).op)) s)
    91	    have h0 : ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    92	        (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl).hom s =
    93	        (((relCurveMap C B B').app ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom s) :=
    94	      congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    95	        $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (relCurveMap C B B')
    96	          (U := (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))) s)
    97	    calc relSectionsMap C B B' V s
    98	        = ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    99	            ((fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   100	            (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)).hom s := rfl
   101	      _ = (relCurve C B').resHom (le_of_eq (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).symm)
   102	            (((relCurveMap C B B').appLE ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   103	              (relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))
   104	              le_rfl).hom s) := h.symm
   105	      _ = _ := by rw [h0]
   106	  rw [happ, Scheme.basicOpen_resHom,
   107	    ← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen (relCurveMap C B B') s,
   108	    ← relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V, ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
   109	  congr 1
   110	  exact inf_eq_right.mpr ((relCurve C B).basicOpen_le s)

   112	/-! ## The comparison intertwines the structure algebra maps (arbitrary opens) -/
   113	
   114	/-- `appLE` is invariant under an equality of morphisms. -/
   115	private lemma appLE_congr_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) {U : Y.Opens}
   116	    {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
   117	    f.appLE U W e = g.appLE U W (h ▸ e) := by
   118	  subst h; rfl

   121	
   122	/-- **The comparison intertwines the structure actions, on arbitrary opens**: the
   123	`appLE` image of the structure pullback of `r : B` is the structure pullback of
   124	`algebraMap B B' r` (the landed `relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap` is the pullback-open
   125	case `W = V_B`). -/
   126	theorem relCurveMap_appLE_overAlgebraMap {W : (relCurve C B).Opens}
   127	    {W' : (relCurve C B').Opens} (hle : W' ≤ relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ W) (r : B) :
   128	    ((relCurveMap C B B').appLE W W' hle).hom
   129	        ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B W r) =
   130	      (relCurve C B').overAlgebraMap B' W' (algebraMap B B' r) := by
   131	  have hmor : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).inv ≫

1	/-

     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     7	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not prove that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme, and it reserves `DivRankOneOpen` for the
    21	future actual open subscheme of the divisor representer.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
    60	
    61	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
    62	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
    63	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    64	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
    65	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    66	
    67	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
    68	representer. -/
    69	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    70	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    71	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    72	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    73	
    74	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    75	def rankOneAbelAff :
    76	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
    77	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    78	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    79	
    80	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    81	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
    82	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    83	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
    84	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    85	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    86	
    87	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    88	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    89	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    90	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    91	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
    92	
    93	end
    94	
    95	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModuleKSheaf
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
    74	
    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	namespace Modules
    91	
    92	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    93	
    94	/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    98	
    99	end Modules
   100	
   101	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies

     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.

    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)

    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫

# Sheaves of modules over a sheaf of rings

In this file, we define the category `SheafOfModules R` when `R : Sheaf J RingCat`
is a sheaf of rings on a category `C` equipped with a Grothendieck topology `J`.

universe v v₁ u₁ u w

/-- A sheaf of modules is a presheaf of modules such that the underlying presheaf
of abelian groups is a sheaf. -/
structure SheafOfModules where
  /-- the underlying presheaf of modules of a sheaf of modules -/
  val : PresheafOfModules.{v} R.obj

namespace SheafOfModules

variable {R}

/-- A morphism between sheaves of modules is a morphism between the underlying
presheaves of modules. -/
@[ext]
structure Hom (X Y : SheafOfModules.{v} R) where
  /-- a morphism between the underlying presheaves of modules -/
  val : X.val ⟶ Y.val

instance : Category (SheafOfModules.{v} R) where
  Hom := Hom
  id _ := ⟨𝟙 _⟩
  comp f g := ⟨f.val ≫ g.val⟩

@[ext]
lemma hom_ext {X Y : SheafOfModules.{v} R} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f.val = g.val) : f = g :=
  Hom.ext h

@[simp]
lemma id_val (X : SheafOfModules.{v} R) : Hom.val (𝟙 X) = 𝟙 X.val := rfl

@[simp, reassoc]
lemma comp_val {X Y Z : SheafOfModules.{v} R} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (f ≫ g).val = f.val ≫ g.val := rfl

variable (R)
/-- The forgetful functor `SheafOfModules.{v} R ⥤ PresheafOfModules R.val`. -/
@[simps]
def forget : SheafOfModules.{v} R ⥤ PresheafOfModules R.obj where
  obj F := F.val
  map φ := φ.val

/-- The forget functor `SheafOfModules R ⥤ PresheafOfModules R.val` is fully faithful. -/
@[simps]
def fullyFaithfulForget : (forget.{v} R).FullyFaithful where
  preimage φ := ⟨φ⟩

instance : (forget.{v} R).Faithful := (fullyFaithfulForget R).faithful

instance : (forget.{v} R).Full := (fullyFaithfulForget R).full

instance : (forget.{v} R).ReflectsIsomorphisms := (fullyFaithfulForget R).reflectsIsomorphisms

`SheafOfModules R ⥤ ModuleCat (R.val.obj X)`. -/
def evaluation (X : Cᵒᵖ) : SheafOfModules.{v} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} (R.obj.obj X) :=
  forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ X

/-- The forget functor `SheafOfModules R ⥤ Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat`. -/
@[simps]
noncomputable def toSheaf : SheafOfModules.{v} R ⥤ Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v} where
  obj M := ⟨_, M.isSheaf⟩
  map f := { hom := (forget R ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf R.obj).map f }

noncomputable def toSheafCompSheafToPresheafIso :

lemma add_val {M N : SheafOfModules.{v} R} (f g : M ⟶ N) :

abbrev sections (M : SheafOfModules.{v} R) : Type _ := M.val.sections

abbrev sectionsMap {M N : SheafOfModules.{v} R} (f : M ⟶ N) (s : M.sections) : N.sections :=

  map f := ↾(sectionsMap f)

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Ring.Basic

/-!
# Presheaves of modules over a presheaf of rings.

Given a presheaf of rings `R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat`, we define the category `PresheafOfModules R`.
An object `M : PresheafOfModules R` consists of a family of modules
`M.obj X : ModuleCat (R.obj X)` for all `X : Cᵒᵖ`, together with the data, for all `f : X ⟶ Y`,
of a functorial linear map `M.map f` from `M.obj X` to the restriction
of scalars of `M.obj Y` via `R.map f`.


## Future work

* Compare this to the definition as a presheaf of pairs `(R, M)` with specified first part.
* Compare this to the definition as a module object of the presheaf of rings
  thought of as a monoid object.
* Presheaves of modules over a presheaf of commutative rings form a monoidal category.
* Pushforward and pullback.
-/

@[expose] public section

universe v v₁ u₁ u

open CategoryTheory LinearMap Opposite

variable {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}}

variable (R) in
/-- A presheaf of modules over `R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat` consists of family of
objects `obj X : ModuleCat (R.obj X)` for all `X : Cᵒᵖ` together with
functorial maps `obj X ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (R.map f)).obj (obj Y)`
for all `f : X ⟶ Y` in `Cᵒᵖ`. -/
structure PresheafOfModules where
  /-- a family of modules over `R.obj X` for all `X` -/
  obj (X : Cᵒᵖ) : ModuleCat.{v} (R.obj X)
  /-- the restriction maps of a presheaf of modules -/
  map {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y) : obj X ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (R.map f).hom).obj (obj Y)
  map_id (X : Cᵒᵖ) :
    map (𝟙 X) = (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsId' (R.map (𝟙 X)).hom
      (congrArg RingCat.Hom.hom (R.map_id X))).inv.app _ := by
        cat_disch
  map_comp {X Y Z : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    map (f ≫ g) = map f ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars _).map (map g) ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp' (R.map f).hom (R.map g).hom (R.map (f ≫ g)).hom
        (congrArg RingCat.Hom.hom <| R.map_comp f g)).inv.app _ := by cat_disch

namespace PresheafOfModules

attribute [simp] map_id map_comp
attribute [reassoc] map_comp

#adaptation_note /-- https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/pull/12564
This is required for `Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Differentials.Presheaf` -/
instance {R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}} (X : Cᵒᵖ) (M : PresheafOfModules.{v} (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)) :
    Module (R.obj X) (M.obj X) := (M.obj X).isModule

variable (M M₁ M₂ : PresheafOfModules.{v} R)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
protected lemma map_smul {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y) (r : R.obj X) (m : M.obj X) :
    M.map f (r • m) = R.map f r • M.map f m := by simp

lemma congr_map_apply {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) (m : M.obj X) :
    M.map f m = M.map g m := by rw [h]

lemma map_comp_apply {U V W : Cᵒᵖ} (i : U ⟶ V) (j : V ⟶ W) (x) :
    M.map (i ≫ j) x = M.map j (M.map i x) := by
  rw [M.map_comp]; rfl

/-- A morphism of presheaves of modules consists of a family of linear maps which
satisfy the naturality condition. -/
@[ext]
structure Hom where
  /-- a family of linear maps `M₁.obj X ⟶ M₂.obj X` for all `X`. -/
  app (X : Cᵒᵖ) : M₁.obj X ⟶ M₂.obj X
  naturality {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

/-!
# The pinned cocycle datum on the relative curve (DAT-1, stage 1d-i, the datum)

The **cocycle datum over a `k`-algebra `B`** of the Wave-4 datum worksheet §3.2
(BINDING; `informal/spec-dat-1.md` §0), on the pinned relative cover
`relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)` of the relative curve `C_B`:

* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCoverData` — the two finite index types `J₀, J₁`, the
  basic-open generators `h_j ∈ Γ(Vᵢᴮ, 𝒪)` and the partition witnesses
  `∑ j, a_j · h_j = 1` per pinned chart; `pieces` sends `J₀ ⊕ J₁` to the basic opens
  `D(h_j)`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum` — the cover data together with the
  transition units on the pairwise basic-open overlaps (`Units` bundle the inverse
  witnesses) and the cocycle law `Scheme.IsGluingCocycle`.
* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` — the glued sheaf of `B`-modules of the datum
  (`gluedSheaf`), with the quasi-coherence packagings on **both pinned charts** and on
  the **overlap** as instances (`instQcohOn₀/₁/Inf`, from `gluedQcohOn`: side-`i`'s own
  family on chart `i`; side-0's family restricted along `V₀ᴮ ⊓ V₁ᴮ ≤ V₀ᴮ` on the
  overlap, through the subordinate-pieces interface).
* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.pairData` — the two-cover pair data at the pinned relative
  coordinates `t₀ᴮ, t₁ᴮ` (`relFiberCoord₀/₁`), through `gluedPairData` (the
  componentwise-action hypotheses are `rfl` for the keyed instances).

The engine keystones fired on `pairData.pair` are in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafEngine`.
-/

    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.

    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=

    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections

    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x

    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf

    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl

    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl

    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
